fields.statement: Built the branch head (go build -trimpath) and ran go vet ./... clean. With the built binary, rhiza tui app roadmap, model, health, changes, show and live --once each printed 'unknown app' and exited 4; inbox, runs and autonomy --once printed JSON and exited 0, request and daemon gave their no --once usage error (exit 2). The wrapped CLI commands still work: roadmap, slice and change ls exit 0, health prints its parts. The slice shows all 14 old-app capabilities (roadmap-app-*, model-tree-app, model-app-search, modelapp-timing-alone, changes-app, health-app, read-apps-match-cli, write-apps-previewed, runs-sessions-apps) retired, and show no longer finds them. TestScripts/tui-old-apps-gone passes.

Ran the built binary's rhiza rex install with a fake rex on PATH and REX_CONFIG in a scratch folder: it wrote rhiza.lua and the require line and logged one 'config reload'. rhiza.lua holds exactly 5 rex.action entries, rhiza_app_autonomy, daemon, inbox, request and runs, with one key each (y, d, i, q, v) and no old app. rex-app-actions' acceptance now names the five apps. TestScripts/rex-install and internal/api -run RexInstall pass.
